stem.text: What happens to molecules of sucrose when they are heated with acid?

A.text: Glycosidic bonds are broken by condensation using water, releasing only glucose.

B.text: Glycosidic bonds are broken by condensation, releasing fructose, glucose and water.

C.text: Glycosidic bonds are broken by hydrolysis using water, releasing fructose and glucose.

D.text: Glycosidic bonds are broken by hydrolysis, releasing fructose, glucose and water.
